title: Best app planner EVER
body: This app is amazing, I have trouble getting ready in the morning because I get really distracted. My main goal is always to get to school on time. But, I get stuck in these little time consuming rabbit holes of distraction. I just can’t focus in the morning before school. I also have been looking for a schedule app because I am a really busy person. I am a violinist so I constantly have to practice and go to lessons. But, I get stuck in these rabbit holes but now, I can actually function properly. Taking the fact that I am a deep thinker, I usually have to think about like “Hmm, do I have music or physical education today?” in which I lay on the carpet floor and reconsider all my life decisions. But now, my thoughts are no longer in place. So, if you have ADHD, OCD, anxiety (like me) or autism. I would definitely recommend this app. This deserves a 5 star rating.
